notes.subject: עשקו/עשק · גזלו/גזל
notes.rationale: Infinitive-verb doubling ('wokim brukim, brukim') — verb then its own noun — repeated twice, rhythm lost in Tok Pisin.

notes.subject: הגר
notes.rationale: 'man i kamap long narapela ples' renders guest/foreigner; the Hebrew single word for resident-alien.

notes.subject: גזל
notes.rationale: Second noun of the verb+noun doubling rendered as 'samting bilong stil' rather than a bare abstract 'stiling'.

translation: Ol man bilong graun i wokim ⟨את⟩ pasin bilong brukim ol man, na ol i stilim ⟨את⟩ samting; ol man no gat mani na ol man hangre, ol i bagarapim ol; na ol i brukim ⟨את⟩ man i kamap long narapela ples, long i no gat kot.
